note: Production media. Keys are storage-agnostic and carry NO URL: src/lib/media.ts joins a rendition path to PUBLIC_MEDIA_BASE_URL, which is the local mirror in development and the R2 delivery host in production. Rendition names are content-addressed, so a name that matches is bytes that match — that is what makes the cache immutable and the sync a set difference. Regenerate with `npm run media:build`.
